# Daman Reddy — Systems, 3D Environments, BI and Data

> Daman Reddy is based in Hyderabad, India, and works in three crafts: an
> AI-assisted systems developer (local-first, security-hardened software), a trained
> 3D environment artist (MA Animation, University of Salford, Merit), and a BI and
> data analyst (SQL, DuckDB, Power BI, Tableau). Working style: local-first,
> evidence over vibes, measure before shipping.

Site: https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/
Contact: daman.w3d@gmail.com · GitHub @damanjz · ArtStation @damanpsd
Status: Open to work (replies in ~24h)

## How I work (same as the site)
- Systems: Local-first. Measured, then shipped. Threat-model first. AI speeds it up, I own it.
- 3D environments: Composition first. Blockout to beauty. Performance is part of the art. Built for where it lands.
- Data: Every number reconciles. Break it on purpose. Fair by design. Reports as code.

## AI-assisted systems development (https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/systems/)
- [protec](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/protec/): A password manager that never phones home — Rust core, encrypted local vault, Windows Hello unlock, browser extension over native messaging. 16 hardening fixes from a six-agent audit. Public: https://github.com/damanjz/protec
- [n8n-automation](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/n8n-automation/): Self-hosted AI support triage on local Ollama — routes tickets and drafts KB-grounded replies for human approval, gated by a 40-case eval corpus (88% vs 70% baseline). Private.
- [volt-techwear-store](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/volt-techwear-store/): A full Next.js 15 techwear storefront — membership identity, clearance-gated access, secure Server Action checkout, Prisma/Postgres/NextAuth. Public: https://github.com/damanjz/volt-techwear-store
- [flux-player](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/flux-player/): A native Windows video player in Python + PySide6 (Qt) — a homage to Windows Media Player 12, no web wrapper. Public: https://github.com/damanjz/flux-player
- [ai-calendar](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/ai-calendar/): An open-source calendar with a React web app and a Node/Express REST API so AI assistants can check availability, spot conflicts and book events (local file, Google, Outlook, CalDAV); 177 tests, about 96% line coverage. Public: https://github.com/damanjz/ai-calendar
- [obsidian-vault-mcp](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/obsidian-vault-mcp/): A read-only Model Context Protocol server (TypeScript, stdio, MCP SDK + zod only) that lets an AI assistant search an Obsidian vault: search, read_note, backlinks, outgoing_links, list_notes. No write calls, no network; path traversal, dot-folders and links outside the vault refused; 49 tests including end-to-end over stdio. Public: https://github.com/damanjz/obsidian-vault-mcp
- [fde-support-agent](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/fde-support-agent/): Support agent for a fictional coffee-gear brand: hybrid retrieval with citations, four tools, writes only after the customer confirms; 88% on a 60-case eval (mean of 3 runs) vs 85% keyword-only and 37% without retrieval, local 27B model, INR 0 per query. Public: https://github.com/damanjz/fde-support-agent
- [fde-integration-hub](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/fde-integration-hub/): Webhook hub delivering order events to warehouse, helpdesk and accounting through a Postgres outbox with leases, HMAC, OAuth2, rate limits and a circuit breaker; chaos run of 1,476 deliveries with 0 lost, 0 duplicates, 0 ordering violations. Public: https://github.com/damanjz/fde-integration-hub
- [fde-doc-extraction](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/fde-doc-extraction/): Invoice and delivery-note extraction (PDF and OCR) with validation in code (GSTIN checksum, sums, tax rules); 0 silent errors in 1,130 fields and 0 bad documents auto-accepted vs 17 for raw LLM extraction. Public: https://github.com/damanjz/fde-doc-extraction
- [fde-ask-your-data](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/fde-ask-your-data/): Text-to-SQL over a 12-month warehouse with a read-only, PII-free database role and checked summaries; 36/40 (90%) on gold questions vs 17/40 for a raw-schema baseline. Public: https://github.com/damanjz/fde-ask-your-data
- [fde-eval-harness](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/fde-eval-harness/): Eval and regression gate across models: paired McNemar, exact bootstrap, Wilson intervals; measured a 4-of-60 noise floor and blocked a faster model that failed 2 of 10 safety cases. Public: https://github.com/damanjz/fde-eval-harness
- [fde-voice-intake](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/fde-voice-intake/): Voice front end for the support agent (faster-whisper and Piper on CPU): 25/25 spoken requests end to end on synthetic speech, quiet clips never reach the agent, hedged answers never confirm an action. Public: https://github.com/damanjz/fde-voice-intake

## BI and data analysis (https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/data/)
- [finance-bi](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/finance-bi/): A BI case study on five years of synthetic personal-finance records — DuckDB/SQL model reconciled by 15 checks, and a four-question Power BI report generated from code, its measures matched to SQL exactly. Public: https://github.com/damanjz/personal-finance-bi
- [hr-analytics](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/hr-analytics/): People analytics for a synthetic 2,500-person IT services firm — attrition, hiring, eNPS and pay equity in DuckDB, a flight-risk model (out-of-time ROC AUC 0.658) that never sees gender, and a Tableau workbench generated from code. Live: https://public.tableau.com/app/profile/daman.reddy/viz/HRAnalyticsWorkbench/Workbench · Public: https://github.com/damanjz/hr-analytics

- [hospital-operations](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/hospital-operations/): Three years of a synthetic 256-bed Hyderabad hospital: patient flow, bed occupancy and 30-day readmissions in DuckDB (18 checks), a readmission model at ROC AUC 0.786 vs 0.749 for the LACE score, and a Power BI report generated from code whose 63 numbers match SQL. Public: https://github.com/damanjz/hospital-operations-bi
- [supply-chain](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/supply-chain/): Three years of a synthetic Indian FMCG distributor: OTIF, lead time, inventory and supplier performance in DuckDB (15 checks), a 14-day stockout model at ROC AUC 0.840 vs 0.699 for the reorder-point rule, and a Tableau workbook generated from code. Live: https://public.tableau.com/app/profile/daman.reddy/viz/SupplyChainNetwork_17913286536000/Network · Public: https://github.com/damanjz/supply-chain-bi
- [saas-revenue-leak](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/saas-revenue-leak/): A B2B SaaS revenue engine graded against a sealed answer key: five revenue leaks planted in a simulated business (1,107 accounts, Oct 2024 to Sep 2026); the dbt/DuckDB warehouse, a six-detector leak monitor and a churn model found 5 of 5 on the main run, 19 of 20 across four worlds; churn AUC 0.73 out of time; Power BI generated from code, 69 of 69 numbers match DuckDB. Public: https://github.com/damanjz/saas-revenue-leak-bi
- [india-air-quality](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/india-air-quality/): The first BI piece on real data: government air-quality monitoring (CPCB and state boards, via the OpenAQ archive) in Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Bengaluru and Hyderabad, 107 stations, hourly 2019 to Sep 2026. Nothing filled in: a 27-month archive gap left blank, mislabelled units relabelled, fault code 985, frozen sensors and conflicting duplicate feeds set aside (1,089,800 readings, each under a named reason). DuckDB star schema with CPCB National AQI; 23 of 23 checks, 23 of 23 mutations caught; a 5-page Power BI report and an Excel workbook generated from code, 423 of 423 report numbers match SQL. Data credited to CPCB and state boards via OpenAQ, licence per provider. Public: https://github.com/damanjz/india-air-quality-bi

## 3D environment art (https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/art/)
- [Umbraxis](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/umbraxis/): A semi-stylized medieval-village environment in Unreal Engine 5.6 (Lumen, Nanite) — ~100 fps against a 60 fps target. MA Animation technical showcase.
- [Cinematic Car Render](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/cinematic-car/): A low-key Blender/Cycles studio lighting study — a sports car read through rim light and colored gels on near-black.
- [Stylized Studies](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/stylized-studies/): Cel-shaded (NPR) pieces and Geometry-Nodes procedural generators (castle, city, flock) in Blender.
- [Product Placement Dev](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/product-placement-dev/): Looks-dev for signature electric guitars — low-key studio lighting, texturing, compositing, cut to 9:16 social reels.
- [Procedural Clouds](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/procedural-clouds/): A golden-hour volumetric cloud study in Blender.
- [Cityscape](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/cityscape/): A dense procedural downtown rendered in greyscale clay — scale from geometry.
- [Highway Night Stop](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/highway-stop/): A nocturnal roadside scene lit by fog, sodium light and neon.
- [Interior Study](https://damanjz.github.io/portfolio/projects/interior-study/): A warm evening living-room lighting-and-materials study in Blender.

## Stack
Engineering: Rust, Python, Tauri, PySide6. Web: TypeScript, Next.js 15, Svelte, Prisma/Postgres. AI: FastAPI, Postgres + pgvector, hybrid retrieval, tool calling, evals, faster-whisper, Piper. Ops: Docker, n8n, Ollama, GitHub Actions. 3D: Unreal Engine 5, Blender, Substance Painter.
